interventions.label: Recite the Saturn beej mantra 'Om Praam Preem Praum Sah Shanaye Namah' 108 times daily on Saturday, facing east. Complete mahadasha-count japa over the dasha period.
interventions.citation: G27 remedy saturn_matrix_mantra for Saturn

interventions.label: Chant the Shani Ashtottara Shatanamavali (108 names of Saturn) or the Shani Chalisa daily, especially on Saturdays. Saturn rules karma, discipline, and professional perseverance.

interventions.label: For Saturn-ruled chronic disease (bones, joints, nervous system; Saturn in 6H/8H or Sade Sati with health impact): perform Mahamrityunjaya japa to the prescribed count — 1,25,000 (1.25 lakh) for a full shanti, or 108 daily as ongoing maintenance. The mantra is from Rigveda 7.59.12 (Tryambaka sukta) and is the classical prescription for Mrityu-related (Saturn/8H) afflictions.
interventions.citation: Rigveda 7.59.12 (Tryambaka sukta); BPHS Ch.88 (Shani upaya)

interventions.label: Recite the Saturn beej mantra 'Om Praam Preem Praum Sah Shanaye Namah' 108 times daily on Saturday, facing east. Complete mahadasha-count japa over the dasha period.
interventions.citation: BPHS (Brihat Parasara Hora Sastra), Ch.88-94 (Upaya-adhyaya)

interventions.label: Saturday dana for Saturn (BPHS Ch.93): donate black sesame (til), iron vessel, mustard oil, dark blue/black cloth, and shoes to a laborer or the destitute on Saturdays. BPHS Ch.93 specifies black sesame and iron as the canonical Saturn dana pair. Feeding crows (Saturn's bird) bread soaked in mustard oil on Saturdays is an additional classical prescription.
interventions.citation: BPHS (Brihat Parasara Hora Sastra), Ch.88-94 (Upaya-adhyaya)

interventions.label: Donate black sesame seeds (til), black cloth, mustard oil, iron vessels, or sesame ladoos to laborers or the poor on Saturdays. Feed crows, who are Saturn's birds.
interventions.citation: BPHS (Brihat Parasara Hora Sastra), trans. Rishi Kumar Shastri, public domain

interventions.label: Chant the Shani Ashtottara Shatanamavali (108 names of Saturn) or the Shani Chalisa daily, especially on Saturdays. Saturn rules karma, discipline, and professional perseverance.
interventions.citation: BPHS (Brihat Parasara Hora Sastra), trans. Rishi Kumar Shastri, public domain

interventions.label: For Saturn affliction, Sade Sati, or Mars-Saturn conjunction (Angarak yoga): recite Hanuman Chalisa (Tulsidas, 16th c., 40 verses) daily. Classical tradition holds Hanuman pacifies both Saturn (per Ramayana tradition: Hanuman is the Shatru of Shani) and Mars (as the deity of Mars in some schools). This is the most widely prescribed Saturn-pacification stotra in North Indian tradition.
interventions.citation: Tulsidas, Hanuman Chalisa (16th c.); classical tradition

interventions.label: Watering and lighting an oil lamp beneath the Shaami tree (Prosopis cineraria) on Saturdays is the canonical Saturn dana-in-kind from BPHS Ch.94. The Shaami is Saturn's sacred tree. Also: reciting the Shani mantra under the Shaami on Saturdays during Sade Sati is the classical prescription.
interventions.citation: BPHS (Brihat Parasara Hora Sastra), Ch.88-94 (Upaya-adhyaya)

interventions.label: For birth in Pushya nakshatra: recite the nakshatra devata mantra 'Om Brihaspataye Namah' 108 times daily, especially on the day ruled by Saturn. The presiding deity is Brihaspati. This propitiation pacifies afflictions to the natal Moon/lagna when in this nakshatra and is prescribed for nakshatra shanti in BPHS Ch.94.
interventions.citation: BPHS (Brihat Parasara Hora Sastra), Ch.88-94 (Upaya-adhyaya)

interventions.label: For birth in Anuradha nakshatra: recite the nakshatra devata mantra 'Om Mitraya Namah' 108 times daily, especially on the day ruled by Saturn. The presiding deity is Mitra. This propitiation pacifies afflictions to the natal Moon/lagna when in this nakshatra and is prescribed for nakshatra shanti in BPHS Ch.94.
interventions.citation: BPHS (Brihat Parasara Hora Sastra), Ch.88-94 (Upaya-adhyaya)

interventions.label: For Sade Sati: recite Hanuman Chalisa daily (Hanuman pacifies Saturn). Recite Shani Chalisa on Saturdays. Offer mustard oil to Shani idol on Saturdays. Feed crows (Saturn's bird) on Saturdays. The 7.5-year period is a phase of maturation through pressure — endurance and ethical conduct are the real remedy.
interventions.citation: classical tradition (Jyotish)

interventions.label: Adopt Saturn-strengthening conduct: serve the significations of Saturn (e.g. its karaka domain, its deity Shani/Hanuman), avoid its signification-harming actions, and live per its dharma. Behavioral alignment is the deepest remedy — it changes the karma, not just the symptom.
interventions.citation: classical tradition (Jyotish)

interventions.label: Complete the Saturn mantra japa to its mahadasha count over the dasha period: recite 'Om Praam Preem Praum Sah Shanaye Namah' on Saturdays and daily. Standard counts: Sun 7,000; Moon 11,000; Mars 10,000; Mercury 9,000; Jupiter 19,000; Venus 16,000; Saturn 23,000; Rahu 18,000; Ketu 17,000.
interventions.citation: classical tradition (Jyotish)

interventions.label: For birth in Uttara Bhadrapada nakshatra: recite the nakshatra devata mantra 'Om Ahir Budhnyaya Namah' 108 times daily, especially on the day ruled by Saturn. The presiding deity is Ahir Budhnya. This propitiation pacifies afflictions to the natal Moon/lagna when in this nakshatra and is prescribed for nakshatra shanti in BPHS Ch.94.
interventions.citation: BPHS (Brihat Parasara Hora Sastra), Ch.88-94 (Upaya-adhyaya)

interventions.label: Wear a tested Blue Sapphire (Neelam) in iron on the prescribed finger, on Saturday, during Shukla Paksha. ONLY if Saturn is a functional benefic in the chart (test for 3 days first before committing).
interventions.citation: classical ratna-shastra; Phaladeepika (Mantreswara)

interventions.label: Donate black cloth to the needy / a temple / a Brahmin on Saturday (for Saturn propitiation). Consistent donation on the planet's day pacifies its afflictions.
interventions.citation: BPHS (Brihat Parasara Hora Sastra), Ch.88-94 (Upaya-adhyaya)

interventions.label: Worship Shani/Hanuman on Saturday with prescribed flowers, incense and lamp (graha-shanti puja for Saturn). Chant the Saturn Ashtottara (108 names) during the puja.
interventions.citation: classical tradition (Jyotish)

interventions.label: For Sade Sati: donate black sesame, mustard oil, iron, and black cloth to laborers or the poor on Saturdays throughout the 7.5-year period. Service to the elderly and underprivileged is the most direct Saturn remedy.
interventions.citation: classical tradition (Jyotish)

interventions.label: Donate iron to the needy / a temple / a Brahmin on Saturday (for Saturn propitiation). Consistent donation on the planet's day pacifies its afflictions.
interventions.citation: BPHS (Brihat Parasara Hora Sastra), Ch.88-94 (Upaya-adhyaya)
